name: What are the most durable materials for kitchen cabinet construction?

mainEntity.name: What are the most durable materials for kitchen cabinet construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plywood boxes with solid wood face frames offer the strongest durability and best moisture resistance. Plywood holds screws firmly, supports heavy stone countertops without sagging, and resists moisture exposure better than medium-density fiberboard (MDF) or particleboard. For door fronts, solid hardwoods like maple, cherry, or oak offer high impact resistance. If you prefer a smooth, painted finish that will not crack along wood grain joints due to humidity swings, high-density fiberboard (HDF) door panels are an excellent choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plywood box construction paired with solid wood face frames and hardwood or high-density fiberboard doors provides the best strength, screw retention, and longevity.
